rows = pgUsers["data"] or []
domains = Counter()
for r in rows:
    email = (r.get("email") or "").lower()
    domains[email.split("@")[-1] if "@" in email else "unknown"] += 1
active = sum(1 for r in rows if r.get("is_active"))
total = len(rows)
dates = [dtparser.isoparse(r["created_at"]) for r in rows if r.get("created_at")]
